gap: Not established: every maker page and manual I tried was blocked (HTTP 429 on all Shopify stores, HTTP 0, 403, or page text cut off before the body), so I opened no page that states which connection modes keep rapid trigger and at what polling rate, and I cannot say what the results ChatGPT got lack.
standout_why: No comparison was possible. The cited rival pages (attackshark.com X65 Pro HE and X68 Pro HE) returned HTTP 429 on four WebFetch attempts and HTTP 0 on two storecheck.py attempts, and aulatechstore.com returned 429, so I read none of them. The only view of them is ChatGPT's own answer in the brief, which says the X65 Pro HE and X68 Pro HE drop from 8,000 Hz wired to 1,000 Hz wireless. The 0 means no sourced finding, not that a rival already has it.
decides: Nothing from this angle changes or confirms the pick. The compatibility table (rapid trigger, polling rate and configurator access per connection mode, per board) still has to be built from the maker pages once the stores stop throttling. The only per-mode figure on hand is the one already in the brief's record for the Gamakay TK75 TMR (8,000 Hz wired and 2.4 GHz, 1,000 Hz Bluetooth, credited to HLPlanet), which I did not re-open.
